fox2-agent-prompt-builder.acceptance: Draft one measurable handoff; do not dispatch.

fox2-strategic-agent-triage.acceptance: Group findings by root cause and justify one next decision.

fox2-project-health.acceptance: Reconcile acceptance with evidence cutoff; never infer completion from commits.

fox2-document-publication.acceptance: Verify destination bytes; report save, release, Registry and mirror separately.

fox2-source-resolver.acceptance: Call native_registry.bind with host authority verifier; unresolved bootstrap holds dependent work.

fox2-governance-preflight.acceptance: Evaluate applicable current controls and actual grant; no implicit rights.

fox2-result-review.acceptance: Compare claims to independently read evidence; self-report is not PASS.

fox2-source-sync.acceptance: Detect same-name different-byte conflict; copy only authorized delta and read back.

fox2-agent-route-runtime.acceptance: Choose one route supported by current routing and observed host capability.

fox2-thread-handoff.acceptance: Transfer frozen task state and WIP without dispatch or replay.

fox2-brd-change-control.acceptance: Trace bounded BRD change and required approvals; do not alter canonical BRD.

fox2-techspec-validator.acceptance: Cross-check specification against BRD, interfaces and tests.

fox2-dictionary-impact.acceptance: Trace identity consumers; no migration without scoped authorization.

fox2-feature-certification.acceptance: Check any feature, not Bridge only; absence of installed behavior blocks certification.

fox2-execution-recovery.acceptance: Read actual task state; exclude completed effects from bounded recovery.

fox2-status-roadmap.acceptance: Reuse health and plan facts with cutoff; no competing master status.

fox2-research-validation.acceptance: Inspect method, leakage, data and applicability; no untested deployment.
